title.narrative: Ratio of elements of the catalogue of measures (Annex I to the Connection Agreement between ENTSOE and Ukrenergo) implemented

description.narrative: Ratio of elements of the catalogue of measures (Annex I to the Connection Agreement between ENTSOE and Ukrenergo) implemented: This indicator expresses Ukrenergos compliance with the requirements of the Operation Handbooks procedures in the form of a ratio between complaint and all procedures. Concretely, these requirements of the cover the areas power and frequency regulation quality, regulation reserves, data transmission, underfrequency load shedding, planning methodology and others. For each of these dimensions various individual items exist that will need to be implemented through new processes. ENTSOEs Compliance Audit Report, which is expected to be finalised by the end of the Project, will form the basis for this indicator, as it is measuring the compliance with the Operation Handbook (or by then the Operation Guideline) processes. Its values will range from 0% to 100%.

description.narrative: Carbon emissions reduction: This indicator measures the minimum carbon emissions that are expected to be avoided through the improved efficiency of the network. It is a highlevel calculation. The precise nature of the reduction is likely going to be much higher. It is based on weighted average network losses of the neighbouring countries compared to Ukraine in 2014. Moreover, the calculations assume that the reduced emissions come from natural gas fired power plants and use a standard conversion factor.
